messages:
nina_sales: Heads up — Ben from ViroHealth wants SOC2 summary + signed pen-test attestation naming their org, and a short network diagram for a 10-day private UAT in eu-north. Need pricing delta and what we can share by 2025-01-10.

omar_se: @hana_compliance quick Q: For eu-north UAT, do we force VPC peering or is temporary VPN allowed? Also will they need SAML metadata or are ephemeral creds ok?

hana_compliance: We can share a redacted SOC2 Type II exec summary and ISO scope. Pen-test attestation yes; Legal signs. We redact PoC steps and internal IPs. Full report needs NDA + legal review. Ephemeral creds are fine for UAT.

client_ben: Procurement: "please include monthly delta and one-time setup fees. Also we prefer CVE IDs in the attestation if available."

legal_bot: Signatory: Claire Zhao, VP Legal. Signing takes up to 48h after final wording approved.

omar_se: Pricing quick quote: EU private node (10d pro-rated) = $1,800 one-time. VPN setup = $900 one-time. Presigned S3 transfer (7d expiry) recommended for evidence.

hana_compliance: Redaction checklist: remove customer PII, full exploit steps, internal logs, nonpublic findings. CVE IDs ok if public. Evidence transfer requires an evidence-handling attestation signed by client.

nina_sales: Action items: 1) @hana_compliance draft redacted pack + attestation by 2025-01-07. 2) @omar_se prepare presigned S3 plan + ephemeral key snippet. 3) Legal to confirm signatory on final by 48h. I'll send amendment with line items after pricing confirmed.

omar_se: Ephemeral key example:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer UAT_KEY" https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/status
```
Keys expire in 14 days by policy.

client_ben: Ok we’ll take redacted pack + CVE list. If we need full report we can put NDA in place but want to avoid delays. Thanks. :thumbsup:
